reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Navimow again
reauth_confirm.description: Navimow access tokens expire after a day or two and the account was issued no refresh token, so signing in again is the normal way to restore the connection.

abort.already_configured: This Navimow account is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Navimow account can be set up. A second one would share the same broker credentials and the two sessions would displace each other.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out generating the Navimow sign-in URL.
abort.missing_configuration: The Navimow integration is not configured.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. Home Assistant needs an externally reachable URL to complete the Navimow sign-in.
abort.oauth_failed: Navimow did not complete the sign-in.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out completing the Navimow sign-in.
abort.reauth_successful: Navimow was signed in again successfully.
abort.cannot_connect: Signed in, but the Navimow cloud would not return the device list for this account.
abort.no_devices: Signed in successfully, but this Navimow account has no mowers on it.
